purpose: Logo alternatives for review; no replacement selected.

concepts.title: Typographic wordmark
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: an alternative logo concept for the README of LLMLean, an open-source project that uses language models to suggest and complete proofs in the Lean theorem prover. Make one polished logo, not a contact sheet. Flat, vector-friendly design with precise shapes, professional typography, generous white space, a white background, and strong small-size legibility. Exact wordmark text: "LLMLean" (uppercase L L M L, lowercase e a n). No tagline, no extra letters, no presentation labels. Avoid check marks, speech bubbles, sparkles, robots, brains, neural-network illustrations, rounded-square app icons, gradients, shadows, 3D effects, and mockup objects. The project should feel like a serious, elegant open-source mathematics and programming tool. Direction A: an understated custom typographic wordmark with no separate icon. Explore a crisp architectural, lightly geometric sans-serif with mathematical precision and distinctive letter construction, but extremely readable. One subtle shared stroke or ligature may connect the two halves of the name if it improves the design. One ink color, near-black. The result should feel deliberately typeset and carefully kerned, not like plain default UI text. Center the horizontal wordmark with balanced whitespace.
